text:
zev: quick flag  the internal KB page on model-onboarding has a dead shortlink in step 2. clicking the smalllink redirects to a 410. staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/kb/model-onboarding#step-2 -> short.link/xyz -> 410. any volunteers to patch?

anya: ack, can take. is this the shortlink we authored a year ago? might be in the frontmatter `related_links` array.

link-scan-bot: automated scan alert: kb/model-onboarding.md -> external shortlink 410 (checked 2026-03-23). Recommendation: replace with canonical internal path or rehost asset.

zev: yes it was a shortlink we created during the doc migration. prefer to replace with canonical path `/guides/model-onboarding/step-2` if that exists.

anya: searching... found `/guides/model-onboarding/validation.md` looks like the right target. I'll update the frontmatter + inline link to point there and add a redirect from the old fragment.

anya: small question  do we add a note in the changelog for shortlink removal? or just a PR body note?

doc-maintainer: PR body note is fine for this. if it's user-facing and could break bookmarks, add a brief redirect in redirects.yaml.

anya: working on PR: copy link -> replace shortlink with `/guides/model-onboarding/validation.md#validation-checks`, update frontmatter `related_links`, and add redirects.yaml entry for `short.link/xyz` -> `/guides/model-onboarding/validation.md`.

anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4299  fixes shortlink -> uses internal path + redirect, adds test asserting no shortlinks remain in that file. reviewers: @zev @doc-maintainer

preview-bot: staging preview available: https://staging.redwood.ai/kb/model-onboarding#step-2 (build 2026-03-23-0812).

zev: quick scan, lgtm. one tiny nit: update the anchor to `#validation-checks` (we standardized anchor names last sprint).

anya: done, pushed force-with-fix. CI green.

link-scan-bot: post-merge scan: no remaining shortlink references in kb/model-onboarding.md.

doc-maintainer: thanks y'all. marking this as closed and adding you to the docs-owners rotation for next month, @anya :clap:
